notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Queries for NS (nameserver) records to identify all authoritative nameservers for a domain. Each NS record is an additional AXFR attempt target — secondary nameservers are often less hardened than primary.

=== CHAINING ===
dig ns domain → list all nameservers → attempt dig axfr @each-NS → try zone transfer against every NS before assuming it's blocked.

=== WHY MULTIPLE NS ===
Administrators often harden the primary nameserver but forget secondary/tertiary NSes. Zone transfer attempts should be made against every NS record, not just the first one returned.
